_about: Inactive publication audit, not a draw. All supplied numerical values are measured fit inputs or source-defined model settings, with source/section inherited from the enclosing record. Missing inputs are null/unknown. Formal errors are not full systematics or independent covariance. See docs/sources/vokrouhlicky-2024-trojans.md.

source.title: Orbital and absolute magnitude distribution of Jupiter Trojans
source.citation: Vokrouhlický, D., Nesvorný, D., Brož, M., Bottke, W. F., Deienno, R., Fuls, C. D. & Shelly, F. C. (2024). Orbital and absolute magnitude distribution of Jupiter Trojans. arXiv:2401.15537v1 (author manuscript, submitted to AJ).

L4Extension.reason: §5.2: cautionary fit, local slope at H=15 inconsistent with nominal fit; improved detection modeling/data needed.

background.label: measured
background.density: Product of A^alpha1 exp[-0.5(A/sA)^alpha2], B^beta1 exp[-0.5(B/sB)^beta2], exp[-0.5((C-1.5)/sC)^gamma], restricted to numerical coupled stability region.
background.slopeDefinition: Mean slopes of log10 cumulative N(<H), not differential power-law coefficients. Table caption says seven segments but lists six, consistent with six gamma rows and §5.2.

familySignedPowerConvention.label: unknown
familySignedPowerConvention.reason: Eqs. 10–11 print signed offsets with noninteger exponents and no absolute values or support restriction below Aref/Bref; Eq. 12 also has Cref above Cmin for two families.

reportedSlopeChange.note: Not a complete spline fit; last segment described as inexact.
Not a complete spline fit; last segment underestimated and overlaps Ennomos.

stability.boundary: First bins with 50% partial instability for each B value; curves shown in figures, numerical bin mask not tabulated. Symmetric L4/L5 stability does not remove coupling among A/B/C.

osculatingMapping.inclinationAndNode: sin(I) exp(i Omega) = sin(I_J) exp(i Omega_J) + A exp(i phi)
osculatingMapping.eccentricityAndPerihelion: e exp(i(varpi-varpi_J)) = e_J exp(±i pi/3) + B exp(i psi)
osculatingMapping.semimajorAxisAndLongitude: Joint inversion of (da/a_J)^2 = 8 mu/3 [C-f(sigma)] and da = 0.2783 (sigma-chiStar) tan(theta); both polar branches, chiStar=±pi/3; not independent marginals.

polarScale.label: measured
polarScale.note: Eq. 19 prints coefficient without explicit angular/unit convention; retain as printed pending clarification.

osculatingMapping.angleLaw: §4.1: phi, psi, theta uniform on a full turn; theta is shifted/scaled polar angle on the C isoline, not uniform sigma.
osculatingMapping.origin: heliocentric elements; stability integrations correct the center for omitted terrestrial planets
osculatingMapping.frameNote: MPC-derived heliocentric elements and ecliptic language; exact equinox/rotation and Eq. 19 unit convention not explicitly stated in model sections. No invariable-frame transform like the Hilda Appendix is supplied.
osculatingMapping.productEpochMapping: Analytical approximate mapping is supplied; paper initializes at MJD 60000. A product implementation would require sourced same-frame Jupiter a/e/I/Omega/varpi/lambda and mass ratio at its epoch, resolved units/axes, and declared epoch transfer. No such implementation is enabled.

catalogue.note: Public numerical proper elements/HCM membership differ from fitted quasi-proper A/B/C. Table 1 masks are fixed from biased observed families; observed membership counts cannot replace fitted normalizations. Index only read; catalogue not downloaded in this continuation.

uncertainty: §5.2: strongly correlated orbital parameters; overlapping/diffuse L5 families and sparse faint detections. Faint L5 flattening beyond about H=14 is an artifact not to be trusted; L4 extension is cautionary. No full posterior covariance, individual orbit error budget, debiased colour/albedo/rotation law or supported extension to the current faint floor follows from this paper.
